create or alter procedure [fusion].[UpdateFusionTextPaths] @FusionID int as begin set nocount on;
WITH hierarchy (id, itempath) AS ( SELECT id, cast(name as nvarchar(2500)) FROM fusionattribute WHERE fusionid = @FusionID and parentid is null
UNION ALL
SELECT gp.id, cast(gps.itempath + '.' + gp.name as nvarchar(2500)) FROM fusionattribute gp JOIN hierarchy gps ON gps.id = gp.parentid ) UPDATE T set T.textpath = cte.itempath from fusionattribute T inner join hierarchy cte on cte.id = T.id where T.TextPath <> cte.itempath OPTION (MAXRECURSION 10) end
